question: Where and upon whom should meditation be performed at the beginning of the body?
premises: The starting point is the body or its beginning.
The object is Durgā praised by the gods.
inference: One should meditate at the beginning of the body on Durgā, who is praised by the gods.
uncertainties: śarīra+ādau may refer to the beginning of the body or the start of bodily nyāsa.
plain_english: At the beginning of the body one should meditate on Durgā, praised by the gods.
